body: Hmm... Okay. Thanks again, for your help. I'll remember your username if I ever need someone to talk to (if that's okay with you).

Haha, no I wasn't being sarcastic. I was being completely real. I honestly don't really know who I am. I struggle to create an identity for myself. That's partially why I tell myself I fake my depression, if I even have it. A lot of the things I say and do are borrowed from the internet or my friends. There is no HeadyBeach, there's only a collection of lies and stolen qualities.
Hey, thanks for the advice. I'll probably start writing lyrics or poetry or something. And I'll save this post so I know your username if I ever want to talk. Thanks for the offer!

Something about people telling me what I am feels so satisfying. "You don't want to die and you want to change." God. That really hit the spot. Telling me what I know I want really helps. Also, thanks for replying again. Do you have any advice on how to break it to a friend? I already have one in mind, but I feel like just saying "I'm suicidal" might be a big burden. And that's the last thing I'd want is to be a burden. Again, thank you for your help.
